name: Wiki box and crawler
ownerWords: fix plan and duties based on the board skill and pursue completion of plans ... things are meant to be first written in plan -> achieved -> cleared & written on duty for maintanence only -> and valiantly persued whenever not met. JUST DO IT
goal: No risk on the Pinterest index risk page (wiki projects/pinterest-index-gaps/risks) fires: the wiki box us-metal02 has at least 30 days of free disk left at the last 24 h rate, and the crawler's Pinterest reads got no 429 in the last 24 h. Tell the owner only when a risk fires with no fix moving it.

metrics.label: Risks on the Pinterest index risk page that fire
Days until the wiki box us-metal02's disk is full at the last 24 h rate
Crawler Pinterest reads that failed with a 429 in 24 h

onMiss: Fix a source_error first. For each firing line add one fix step under goal p1 with duty "<dutyId>/risks_firing" naming that risk, or steer the live job already on it, or start one job with rlm.create_session that fixes it, and set the step's duty, job and sessionId. wiki_disk_days under 30: find what wrote the space on us-metal02 with find -xdev -newermt, stop the repeat at its source and free only copies and caches whose owner session has ended. pinterest_429_24h over 0: a Pinterest reader is back, so measure 429s over reads and land a change that slows or spreads its reads. When a risk is added to the risk page, add its check to the precheck in the same change. All on target: no message.
